assessment_scope: Formal lifecycle Design Review, first pass, exact registered design/skill/system package and inline label-normalization example; approved proposal-review supports direction. Examined source aids and replacement technical method for preservation and affected consumer boundaries.

findings.evidence: Finding ID: RDA-DR-01. Severity: medium. Scope: artifact-local; affected artifact ID design; owning stage design. Location docs/design/skill/authoring/design.md, Example: a small model document, four scenario rows. The frozen348dc740 diff adds DES-SR-24 to the synthetic LAB example despite no such local requirement. Two non-applicable rows now read -, DES-SR-24. Extracting the complete fence and calling lib.validation.boundary_first_validation.validate_model_record returns BFR-MODEL-REFERENCES. This violates DES-SR-11/12 and the declared complete illustrative model contract.
findings.required_outcome: Restore internally valid synthetic example references and preserve its original label-normalization meaning. Safe resolution: remove only the four accidental DES-SR-24 insertions inside the fenced example, retain DES-SR-24 in the real Design acceptance table, validate the extracted example plus affected models, refresh exact model registration/evidence and return for independent reassessment. No owner policy decision is needed.

independence_basis: Reviewer /root/retirement_review independently read the complete three-member Design package and affected embedded example at frozen348dc740; root authored the reviewed Design amendments. Reviewer authored no engineering content and writes only this review and finding. Prior proposal review is separate scope.
limitations: Approval is withheld pending correction and independent reassessment of RDA-DR-01; this review does not authorize planning reliance or implementation.
No package build or target-agent execution occurred in this Design Review. Implementation resource reconciliation and concrete proof remain downstream.
rationale: Behavior and realization: DES-SR-24 prohibits create/rebuild/amend standalone architecture/ADR output, preserving reads and authorized scoped adoption. Existing source-selection/technical resources can implement this without new runtime, schema or installation behavior.

Authority and compatibility: the package openly withdraws old output support, leaves project documents and authority unchanged absent explicit adoption, prevents template presence from re-enabling output, and retains feature-spec/proof support via DES-SR-14/23. No implementation convenience weakens the approved direction.

Ownership and recovery: Design remains supported-output owner; System/Skill defer to it, while Assessment, Workflow, CLI/Records and Packaging retain their operations. Coherent source/consumer rollback and historical judgment preservation remain explicit. No external permission is inferred.

Decision and migration preservation: DES-DEC-07 explicitly supersedes only the architecture/ADR part of DES-DEC-04. The five-file map retires fixed packaging and preserves goals, constraints, context, structure, flows, quality, risks, vocabulary, decision alternatives/consequences/follow-up and provenance. Existing technical-design guidance covers these concerns. Repository template copies compare byte-identical to their matching skill assets. Commit643f6cd6d368238f0ca2a5075430634cf9307ad3 supplies recoverable originals.

Consumer reconciliation: Design Review must distinguish source inputs from output members; Plan may consume retained requirements without promising old-format edits. Resource-map/READ/COPY and exclusive-presence checks are implementation consumers explicitly selected for reconciliation. Generic lint fixtures and common diagram styles remain independently useful.

Acceptance: unsupported create/rebuild/amend even with a customer template, preserved files, missing/conflicting adoption authority, explicit obligation mapping, retained feature amendment, source-versus-output review and clean installed resource completeness/retired-resource absence are concrete local/integrated outcomes for Delivery. No target-agent behavior is claimed from structural success.

Views: affected models retain clear responsibility overviews and reasoned Context/Building Block/Runtime/Deployment selection. Design adds a supported-output stop to Building Block and pre-authoring stop in Runtime prose. Existing parent views remain adequate because product owners and deployment boundaries do not change.

Example correctness: RDA-DR-01 is a required artifact-local correction. The complete synthetic label-normalization example now cites DES-SR-24 in Input domain and External/environment and uses -, DES-SR-24 for Identity/authority and Compatibility/migration. DES-SR-24 is absent from LAB requirements and unrelated to label normalization. Calling existing validate_model_record on the extracted fence returns BFR-MODEL-REFERENCES; enclosing-model structural success does not prove example validity.

Upstream applicability: unchanged proposal and original approval retain direction scope; changed feasibility-supporting Design identity is expected and is assessed here, not by retargeting that prior judgment. There are no necessary unresolved policy decisions or missing material evidence; actionable example correction therefore determines changes-requested.
summary: The retirement contract, bounded compatibility withdrawal and preservation map are coherent, but the edited complete label-normalization example contains unrelated undeclared DES-SR-24 references and malformed non-applicable rows. Correct the example before package approval.
